procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/lafayette/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (19/19).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page ('FEDERAL AND JUDICIAL ELECTION' banner); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 18 precincts (11 columns, then Oxford 5/Paris/Philadelphia/Taylor 3/Tula/Union West 4/Yocona Community Center + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections (ending at Chancery 18 Place 1's rows); p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying Chancery 18 Place 2's carry rows, the Circuit 3 sections, and the local sections. The table-B print repeats BENTON's late-header shape exactly: 'Jennifer L. Shackelford' and 'Michael Watts' (Chancery Court 18-Chancery District 18 Place 2's candidates) print as the leading carry rows with no header above them, and the p4 header boxes each label the row block ABOVE them -- so Lafayette's sheet pairs Circuit Court 3 as Place 1 = Bob Whitwell, Place 2 = Gray Tollison, Place 3 = Bart M. Adams + Shirley C. Byers + Steven Patrick Jubera + Kent E. Smith (the Place 3 header prints mid-block, between Jubera and Smith), the same printed pairing and family membership as Benton's sheet, diverging from Union's/Chickasaw's pairing (Place 1 Gray Tollison, Place 2 the Adams/Byers/Jubera block, Place 3 Kent E. Smith, no Whitwell section); the per-county-as-printed disposition carries over, and the seat-blind family roster reads identical across all four Circuit 3 counties. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District (Johnny Baucom, Cliff Johnson, Trent Kelly -- the same House 1 roster); Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes) -- the same CoA 1 roster; Chancery Court 18-Chancery District 18 Place 1 (Jenessa Carter Hicks, Sarah J. Liddy) and Place 2 (Jennifer L. Shackelford, Michael Watts) -- the same Chancery 18 roster Benton prints, names and seats identical; Circuit Court 3 as paired above. Printed totals: Colom 8549, Hyde-Smith 8335, Pinkins 373, Baucom 215, Johnson 8245, Kelly 8792, Hopson 6625, Weddle 8093, D. Barnes 13623, Hicks 4620, Liddy 1683, Shackelford 1744, Watts 7437, Whitwell 13911, Tollison 14019, Adams 5626, Byers 4689, Jubera 4686, Smith 13627.
operator_rows_note: All 19 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (seven precinct cells + printed TOTAL); table-B rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the eighteen precinct headers print complete ('Anchor-Taylor 4' and 'Denmark-Laf Springs-Pine Bluff' confirmed against the county's 2026 primary precinct file spellings).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 3 Place 3: Lafayette-County Court Judge (Tiffany Kilpatrick) and School Board 5-School Board 5 (Kathy Babb Worley) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Circuit 3's three Places print in-county (Place-qualified labels matching the other Circuit 3 counties); Chancery 18's two Places likewise (matching Benton's).
